purpose: Distinguish a weak-generator bottleneck from PM, memory, selector, or treatment failure before formal PM claims.

reference.role: stronger same-provider upper-bound and replacement comparator
reference.selection_reason: Same provider and wrapper as the current generator, materially stronger instruction-following class, public NVIDIA model card, and currently exposed by the authenticated model catalog.

same_stack_lock.role_player: identical ESC-Role revision and dialogue wrapper
same_stack_lock.seed: omit unless the endpoint documents deterministic seed support for both routes
same_stack_lock.retry: same bounded transport policy; failed attempts and terminal invalids retained
same_stack_lock.scoring: identical repaired ESC-RANK runtime, strict ordinal parser, ESC-Judge orientation pairs, guardrails, and cost ledger
same_stack_lock.interleaving: candidate and reference calls interleaved by card to reduce time/provider drift

provider_revision_boundary.interpretation: This is a frozen provider-route comparison, not a bitwise weight-revision reproduction.
required_at_execution: response headers allowed by the client
provider_revision_boundary.fail_closed: If either route disappears or the provider-returned identity changes materially during the interleaved run, label the comparison PROVIDER_SNAPSHOT_UNSTABLE and do not force a verdict.

decision_role.replacement_signal: If the 70B reference is decisively better on executor reliability or at least two E-I-A constructs without an atomic-Risk regression, replace the 8B generator and rerun generator qualification before PM confirmation.
decision_role.retention_signal: Retain the 8B generator only if its hard reliability gates pass and the 70B comparison does not show a preregistered decisive advantage.
decision_role.formal_pm_rule: After generator selection, every learned PM arm and every baseline must use the same selected frozen generator.
